name: gpt-continuum
description: A small, human-centered timer for keeping long ChatGPT conversations moving.

interface.shortDescription: Give long conversations a gentle nudge to continue.
interface.longDescription: Start a visible timer that sends a configurable follow-up message to the current ChatGPT conversation. Built for research and technology work, with no credentials, conversation scraping, or external data storage.
defaultPrompt: Open GPT Continuum and send a continue message every 60 seconds.
